You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — reorganized Breitburn business realized record, ~3-5-year horizon after the 2016 Chapter 11 filing (~2019-2021)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the legal vehicle that emerged from the
> restructuring is privately held and not itself an SEC registrant, there is no
> post-closing public 10-K; the realized record is traced through company/reputable
> press disclosures and a negative EDGAR registration check. This sub-dossier contains
> no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- Breitburn Energy Partners LP filed a Form 15 on March 29, 2018 to terminate
  registration of its Common Units and suspend its Exchange Act reporting duty, stating
  it did not expect to make further filings such as Form 8-K, 10-Q, or 10-K. [SRC: SEC accession 0001357371-18-000015, Form 15-12B, filed 2018-03-29]
- A search of SEC EDGAR's company database for registrants named "Maverick Natural"
  returns no results, and a search for "New Permian" returns no results, indicating
  neither of the two entities that received the Debtors' assets under the confirmed Plan
  is itself an SEC-registered filer. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=maverick+natural&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40&output=atom] [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=new+permian&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40&output=atom]
- Consequently no audited public financial statements (10-K/10-Q) exist for the reorganized business for the ~2019-2021 outcome window, and the
  realized-record facts below rely on reputable press rather than primary SEC filings. [UNVERIFIED — no primary filing for this window]

## Realized business record under private ownership (press-sourced)
- On December 2, 2020 (within the outcome window), a press release described an
  all-equity transaction in which FourPoint Energy, LLC — a separate Anadarko Basin
  producer that had, per the release, spent "several months" in negotiations with its
  key stakeholders to reduce its debt and restructure its balance sheet — was renamed
  Unbridled Resources, LLC and merged into a subsidiary of Maverick Natural Resources.
  [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/12/02/2138279/0/en/Western-Anadarko-Basin-Assets-Formerly-Known-and-Managed-as-FourPoint-Energy-are-Renamed-and-Merged-into-new-Maverick-Natural-Resources-Subsidiary-Unbridled-Resources.html]
- The release states that, through this restructuring, funds and accounts managed by EIG
  Global Energy Partners — also described as Maverick's controlling equity owner —
  became the controlling equity owner of FourPoint by exchanging Senior Secured Notes
  for equity, and that "all past and future liabilities and commitments associated with
  the Company will reside with Maverick." [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/12/02/2138279/0/en/Western-Anadarko-Basin-Assets-Formerly-Known-and-Managed-as-FourPoint-Energy-are-Renamed-and-Merged-into-new-Maverick-Natural-Resources-Subsidiary-Unbridled-Resources.html]
- The acquired position was press-described as spanning approximately 700,000 acres
  across the Granite Wash and Cleveland Sand plays in western Oklahoma and northern
  Texas, and as including midstream entities MidPoint Midstream, LLC and Wheeler
  Midstream, LLC. [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/12/02/2138279/0/en/Western-Anadarko-Basin-Assets-Formerly-Known-and-Managed-as-FourPoint-Energy-are-Renamed-and-Merged-into-new-Maverick-Natural-Resources-Subsidiary-Unbridled-Resources.html]

## Items beyond the fixed ~3-5-year window (noted for context only)
- On August 16, 2024 (beyond the ~2019-2021 window), press reporting stated that EIG was
  exploring a potential sale of Maverick Natural Resources valued at approximately $3
  billion including roughly $800 million of debt, working with Jefferies as advisor on a
  confidential process that reportedly included an asset-backed securitization tied to
  some of Maverick's assets; production was reported at approximately 60,000 boe/d.
  Neither EIG nor Maverick had publicly commented as of that report. [SRC: https://www.offshore-technology.com/news/maverick-owner-eig-explores-sale/]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the entities that received the Debtors' assets under the confirmed Plan
  (LegacyCo / Maverick Natural Resources and New Permian Corp.) are not themselves SEC
  registrants, there is no public audited financial record for the ~2019-2021 outcome
  window; this case is coded **uncertain** on the outcome for lack of a directly
  attributable public financial record. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=maverick+natural&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40&output=atom]
- The traceable realized record within the window is limited to one press-reported
  event: a December 2020 all-equity acquisition in which the Maverick ownership group
  (EIG Global Energy Partners) absorbed a separately-restructured producer (FourPoint
  Energy, renamed Unbridled Resources) into a Maverick subsidiary, with FourPoint's
  liabilities and commitments stated to reside with Maverick going forward. No
  Maverick-level revenue, net income, or reserve figures for the ~2019-2021 window were
  located in the sources reviewed. [SRC: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/12/02/2138279/0/en/Western-Anadarko-Basin-Assets-Formerly-Known-and-Managed-as-FourPoint-Energy-are-Renamed-and-Merged-into-new-Maverick-Natural-Resources-Subsidiary-Unbridled-Resources.html]

[SLICE END]
